caption: The drawing features a single, ornate teapot centered on a plain, beige background. The teapot is predominantly depicted in a deep red color with speckled shading that suggests texture. It has a hexagonal base, a wide, curved body with a narrow neck, and a pointed, domed lid with a triangular finial at the top. The handle is situated on the right side, curving outward with a decorative tip, while the spout on the left arches upward and outward. Both the handle and spout have accents of white and pink highlighting their shapes. The central body of the teapot has an off-white oval panel, bordered by red, and decorated with a simple floral pattern featuring brown stems, green leaves, and red flowers. The composition is symmetrical, with the teapot set against a blank background, drawing attention to its shape and decorative details.
title: Pitcher
